title: The 4 Best Humidifiers Under $40
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for humidifiers under $40, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at humidifiers under $40 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: TaoTronics TT-AH001 Cool Mist Humidifier 4L
products.blurb: Key specs: 4L tank, LED display with humidity readout, Waterless auto shut-off.
strengths: 4L tank and LED humidity readout at a price well under most smart humidifiers
Waterless auto shut-off protects the motor if the tank runs dry overnight
Established track record with a strong ratings history for the price tier
limitations: No app or voice assistant control
Filter is a recurring replacement cost
Smaller effective coverage than 6L smart models

products.name: Vicks Mini Filter-Free Cool Mist Humidifier
strengths: Runs about a day on a fill
limitations: Ultrasonic can leave white dust with hard water
